# Test My Well Water

> Independent, source-cited directory of private well water testing options in the US (health departments, state/university programs, certified labs, fees, state laws). Published by Robert Companies LLC. Informational only, not medical advice. Last updated 2026-10-23. Contact: testmywellwater@robertcompanies.com

## Pages
- [Test My Well Water](https://testmywellwater.com/): Find official, low-cost well water testing programs, certified labs and fees for your state, with sources cited on every page.
- [Where to Get Well Water Tested: Health Dept, Certified Labs & State Programs](https://testmywellwater.com/where-to-get-well-water-tested/): Three official ways to get private well water tested, what EPA says to test yearly, and state-by-state program links with fees.
- [Virginia Well Water Testing: VAHWQP Clinics ($70/kit)](https://testmywellwater.com/virginia/): How Virginia's VAHWQP drinking water clinics work, the $70 kit cost, the 28 items tested, and the rules when buying a home with a well.
- [New Jersey Private Well Testing Act (PWTA) Explained](https://testmywellwater.com/new-jersey/): When NJ law requires well testing at sale or lease, closing rules, landlord duties every 5 years, and the PFAS testing requirement, from NJDEP.
- [Pennsylvania Well Water Testing: Penn State Lab Fees ($60–$220)](https://testmywellwater.com/pennsylvania/): Penn State AASL drinking water test packages and fees, how to get a kit from your county extension office, and sample timing rules.
- [New York Well Water Testing: ELAP Labs & PFAS Pilot](https://testmywellwater.com/new-york/): NYSDOH guidance on testing private wells (bacteria yearly, others every 3–5 years), finding ELAP-certified labs, and the free PFAS testing pilot.
- [Maryland Well Water Testing: MDE Guidance & Certified Labs](https://testmywellwater.com/maryland/): MDE's annual well testing recommendations for Maryland's ~350,000 private-well households, plus where to find a state-certified lab.
- [Well Water Test Kit vs. Certified Lab vs. County Program](https://testmywellwater.com/guides/mail-in-kit-vs-certified-lab-vs-county-program/): Compare free county testing, state/university programs, certified labs and mail-in kits like Tap Score for private well water, with official sources.
- [Well Water Smells Like Rotten Eggs? Causes & What to Test](https://testmywellwater.com/guides/well-water-smells-like-rotten-eggs/): Why well water smells like rotten eggs (hydrogen sulfide), how to tell a water-heater problem from a well problem, and which tests official sources recommend.
- [Buying a House With a Well: Water Testing Checklist](https://testmywellwater.com/guides/buying-a-house-with-a-well/): A 7-step, source-cited checklist for well water testing when buying a home: state laws, lender rules, which tests to order, and well records.
- [How to Collect a Well Water Bacteria Sample](https://testmywellwater.com/guides/how-to-collect-a-well-water-bacteria-sample/): Step-by-step bacteria sampling for well water: sterile bottle, five-minute flush, 100 mL fill, refrigerate, and the 30-hour lab deadline, per Penn State.
- [How Often Should You Test Well Water? (EPA & CDC Guidance)](https://testmywellwater.com/guides/how-often-to-test-well-water/): Test a private well every year for coliform, nitrates, TDS and pH (EPA, CDC), plus right away after floods, repairs or changes in taste or smell.
- [What to Test Well Water For: Yearly Tests & Local Add-ons](https://testmywellwater.com/guides/what-to-test-well-water-for/): The yearly well tests EPA and CDC recommend (coliform, nitrate, TDS, pH), extra tests by local risk, and low-cost packages that bundle them.
- [How Long Do Well Water Test Results Take?](https://testmywellwater.com/guides/how-long-do-well-water-test-results-take/): Published turnaround times: Penn State 10–14 business days, Virginia clinics 4–5 weeks, Loudoun about 6 weeks, plus bacteria shipping deadlines.
- [Coliform-Positive Well Water: What It Means & What to Do](https://testmywellwater.com/guides/coliform-positive-well-water-what-to-do/): What a positive total coliform or E. coli well test means, when to retest, safe drinking water meanwhile, and shock chlorination, from CDC and state health departments.
- [Safe Nitrate Levels in Well Water (EPA 10 mg/L Limit)](https://testmywellwater.com/guides/safe-nitrate-levels-in-well-water/): EPA's 10 mg/L nitrate-nitrogen limit, why it matters for infants, where nitrate comes from, how often to test, and why boiling won't fix it.
- [Loudoun County VA Well Water Testing: $70 VCE Kit, Leesburg](https://testmywellwater.com/virginia/loudoun-county/): Loudoun County's VCE water testing program: $70 kit, Leesburg pickup and drop-off, results in about six weeks, and the 2027 waitlist.
- [Hunterdon County NJ Well Water Testing: Kits, Prices, Phone](https://testmywellwater.com/new-jersey/hunterdon-county/): Where to get a well test kit in Hunterdon County, NJ: Raritan Headwaters $70 basic test, Flemington pickup, phone, and county health department guidance.
- [Chester County PA Well Water Testing Labs & Phone Numbers](https://testmywellwater.com/pennsylvania/chester-county/): Well water testing labs in Chester County, PA from the county health department's list, with phone numbers, plus Penn State's mail-in option from $60.
- [Lancaster County PA Well Water Testing: Extension Office & Labs](https://testmywellwater.com/pennsylvania/lancaster-county/): Lancaster County well testing: Penn State Extension office address, phone and hours, Penn State lab prices ($60–$220), and two local labs.
- [Privacy Policy](https://testmywellwater.com/privacy/): What Test My Well Water does and doesn't collect: no accounts, forms, ads or cookies; aggregate visit counts via GoatCounter; hosted on GitHub Pages.
- [How We Verify Information](https://testmywellwater.com/methodology/): How Test My Well Water researches, cites and dates every fact, and what we leave out when we can't verify it.
- [Michigan Well Water Testing: EGLE Lab, PFAS & Certified Labs](https://testmywellwater.com/michigan/): Michigan EGLE and MDHHS private well testing advice: yearly coliform and nitrate, arsenic and lead every 3–5 years, PFAS once, and how to order an EGLE kit.
- [Florida Well Water Testing: County Health Dept ($20–30) & Labs](https://testmywellwater.com/florida/): Florida DOH advice to test private wells yearly for bacteria and nitrate, county health department testing at about $20–30 per sample, and certified lab search.
- [North Carolina Well Water Testing: NCDHHS Schedule & Labs](https://testmywellwater.com/north-carolina/): NCDHHS private well testing schedule (bacteria yearly, metals and nitrate every 2 years, VOCs every 5), common NC contaminants, and where to test.
- [Ohio Well Water Testing: Yearly Tests & Sampling Tips](https://testmywellwater.com/ohio/): OSU Extension's yearly private well tests for Ohio (coliform, nitrate, pH, TDS), how to work with a lab, and when to call your local health department.
- [Indiana Well Water Testing: IDOH Lab ($10 Tests) & Certified Labs](https://testmywellwater.com/indiana/): Indiana Department of Health well testing advice and state lab prices: $10 bacteria, nitrate or fluoride, $20 arsenic/lead/copper, plus certified lab list.
- [Wisconsin Well Water Testing: DNR Tests & Certified Labs](https://testmywellwater.com/wisconsin/): Wisconsin DNR private well testing: bacteria and nitrate yearly, arsenic every five years (yearly in Brown, Outagamie, Winnebago), result levels and certified labs.
- [Georgia Well Water Testing: DPH Recommendations & UGA Extension](https://testmywellwater.com/georgia/): Georgia DPH well testing advice: yearly coliform (W-35) and a W-33C chemical screen with arsenic and lead every 3 years, through UGA Extension county offices.
- [California Domestic Well Testing: Yearly Tests, ELAP Labs & AB 2454](https://testmywellwater.com/california/): California State Water Board advice for domestic wells: test every year, use an ELAP lab ($100–$400 basic sampling), what to test for, and AB 2454 rental rules.
- [Texas Well Water Testing: AgriLife Advice, $15 TWON Screenings & Labs](https://testmywellwater.com/texas/): Texas A&M AgriLife advice to test wells yearly for nitrate, TDS and bacteria, Texas Well Owner Network screenings (typically $15 per sample) and TCEQ accredited labs.
- [South Carolina Well Water Testing: SCDES $20 Bacteria & $50 Metals Tests](https://testmywellwater.com/south-carolina/): SCDES well water kits: $20 coliform test, $50 metals and minerals, free yearly tests for seniors and people on public assistance, PFAS assessments and certified labs.
- [Minnesota Well Water Testing: MDH Recommendations & Accredited Labs](https://testmywellwater.com/minnesota/): Minnesota Department of Health well testing: coliform and nitrate every year, arsenic, lead and manganese at least once, and how to find an accredited lab.
- [Illinois Well Water Testing: Health Departments, Labs & IDPH Help](https://testmywellwater.com/illinois/): Illinois private well testing: when IDPH says to test, local health department bacteria and nitrate testing, commercial labs, and free help interpreting results.
- [Erie County NY Well Water Testing: County Lab Prices ($18 Coliform)](https://testmywellwater.com/new-york/erie-county/): Erie County Public Health Laboratory well tests: $18 coliform, $35 nitrate, $25 lead or arsenic, Buffalo drop-off rules, and what the county says to test.
- [Onondaga County NY Well Water Testing: Approved Labs & Phone Numbers](https://testmywellwater.com/new-york/onondaga-county/): The three labs Onondaga County's health department lists for well bacteria and nitrate tests, with phone numbers, plus how often to test and who to call.
- [Monroe County NY Well Water Testing: County Sampling Prices ($60 Bacteria)](https://testmywellwater.com/new-york/monroe-county/): Monroe County, NY well testing: health department staff collect samples ($35 trip fee, $60 bacteria, $230 base package), what the county says to test, and how to read results.
- [Oakland County MI Well Water Testing: County Lab & $23 State Bacteria Test](https://testmywellwater.com/michigan/oakland-county/): Oakland County, MI well testing: Health Division lab bottles in Pontiac and Southfield, EGLE state lab prices ($23 coliform/E. coli, $41 nitrate), what to test yearly and how to read results.
- [Prince George's County MD Well Water Testing: Certified Labs & County Help](https://testmywellwater.com/maryland/prince-georges-county/): Well water testing in Prince George's County, MD: MDE-certified labs in Beltsville and Lanham, what UMD Extension says to test yearly, and the county health department's well contacts.
- [Wake County NC Well Water Testing: County Lab Prices ($25 Bacteria, $175 Package)](https://testmywellwater.com/north-carolina/wake-county/): Wake County, NC well testing: $50 trip fee, $175 First Timer's Package, $25 self-collected bacteria test, the Rads Package for eastern Wake uranium and radon, and help paying.
- [Well Water Guides](https://testmywellwater.com/guides/): Source-cited guides on choosing a well water test, sampling, odors and buying a home with a well.
